events.comment: The full two-octave D scale. Tongue only the first note and slur the rest.
C# (all open) to high D (all closed) is 'the break', the trickiest move on the whistle. All six fingers come down at once while the air gets faster.
High D: put all the fingers down together, not one by one, and blow faster.
Coming back down: relax the air as you cross from D to C#.
Break drill: C# D C# D. Move all your fingers as one unit. Go slowly until the D speaks every time.
Slower now: hold each note for two beats.
A little melody that crosses the break several times.

notes: Two octaves of the D scale, plus a drill for 'the break': C# (all holes open) to high D (all closed). All six fingers must land together while the air speeds up. Practise the drill slowly; once C#–D is solid, most tunes open up.
title: Lesson 4: Across the break - C# to high D

Os seis dedos precisam descer juntos enquanto o ar acelera. Pratique o exercício devagar; quando o C#–D estiver firme, a maioria das músicas fica ao seu alcance.
